citations.quote: OAS is option-adjusted spread, which incorporates the value of the embedded call option in certain corporate bonds that issuers have the right to exercise before maturity
investors anticipate credit measures will improve due to rising corporate cash flow, thus reducing the risk of default
quotes on the floating spread are sometimes available in the market, for example, through the asset swap market

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Relative-value screens compare a bond's spread vector (Z-spread, OAS, asset-swap spread) against a tightly-defined peer cohort and flag cheap (z < -1) and rich (z > +1) outliers. The OAS-vs-Z-spread comparison decomposes credit richness from embedded-option richness; the bond-CDS basis surfaces persistent cash-vs-derivative mispricing.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Relative-Value Screens
